history_summary: Ground six overlapping reference descriptors while preserving thermophilic biomethanation assay and causal limits.
history_details: The native crosswalk adds six reference blocks and statuses with two appended native events: Methanobacteriota phylum 2815/5300 at fraction 0.531, Bacillota_A phylum 226306/451729 at fraction 0.501, Coprothermobacterota phylum 32/32, Methanobacteria class 2810/2810, Methanosarcina genus 301/301 and Methanothrix genus 94/117 at fraction 0.803. The two phylum majorities are narrow; Bacillota_A is explicitly a non-type majority and the unsuffixed type-bearing clade has 185026 references. These are filtered reference populations, not source amplicon abundances, viable cells, activity, taxon-specific flux or reactor-stock genome assignments. Preserve the source Euryarchaeota, Firmicutes and Methanosaeta wording, all six overlapping descriptors and absent stock identities. DSM 863, DSM 800 and DSM 6752 in the source are calibration/control cultures, not identified reactor members. Preserve the single-CSTR proof of concept, source phase-average 78/16/4 profile versus day-69 qPCR distinction, total-DNA limitation, sequential-phase confounding, washout alternatives, observed 86-percent methane versus proposed greater-than-90-percent performance, current biological assertions and all source quotations. The captured CLOSED issue 1932 records the prior graph correction; captured OPEN issue 1935 still owns non-graph viability/activity, abundance timing and unqualified role concerns. No such finding is resolved by taxonomy. Keep the two community-level nodes without new interspecies arrows, original history and batch 120 ledger; later strict admission must preserve current biology and the existing 454 C8S5 and 106 C14S5 predecessor chains. The crosswalk release remains unestablished; local NCBI authority is observed by file identity/stat rather than a content digest. This partial technical correction does not complete scientific review, measured references, generated products or corpus QC.
